Massage therapists, bodyworkers, students, and educators—ABMP is here to serve you. With meaningful resources and support that makes a difference in your career, discover why our members expect more, and get more, with ABMP. Learn more about us at https://www.abmp.com/

Listen to The ABMP Podcast at https://www.abmp.com/podcasts or on Apple Podcasts, Spotify, and Google Podcasts.

Read the latest issue of Massage & Bodywork Magazine at http://www.massageandbodyworkdigital.com/read/account_titles/162842
